snippet.description:
Euler-Lagrange Equation Special Cases | Beltrami Identity & Calculus of Variations Solved Problems for CSIR NET, GATE, M.Sc & B.Sc Mathematics lecture.

Iss lecture mein hum Calculus of Variations ke ek behad important topic Euler-Lagrange Differential Equation ke Special Cases ko detail mein samjhenge. Har problem mein complete second-order differential equation solve karne ki zaroorat nahi hoti—agar aap integrand ka nature pehle identify kar lete hain, toh questions chutkiyon mein solve ho jate hain!

📌 Topics Covered in this Video:

Why do we need Special Cases in Calculus of Variations?
Case 1: When $f$ is independent of $y$ ($f_y = 0 \implies f_{y'} = C$) & Momentum Conservation analogy
Case 2: When $f$ is independent of $x$ ($f_x = 0$) & Beltrami Identity derivation ($f - y'f_{y'} = C$)
Solved Problem: Surface of revolution of least area (Catenary curve derivation)
Case 3: When $f$ is independent of $y'$ (No extremals / Degenerate cases)
Case 4: When $f$ is independent of both $x$ and $y$ (Straight lines extremal family & singular branches)
Case 5 (Trap Case): When $f$ is linear in $y'$

Video Timestamps
00:00 – Introduction & Recap of Euler-Lagrange Equation
01:19 – Why Do We Need Special Cases?
03:10 – Beltrami Form Review
04:15 – Case 1: Integrand $f$ is Independent of $y$ ($f_y = 0$)
07:45 – Momentum Conservation Analogy
08:54 – Example 1: Solved Problem for Case 1
13:02 – Case 2: Integrand $f$ is Independent of $x$ ($f_x = 0$)
14:38 – Derivation of Beltrami Identity ($f - y'f_{y'} = C$)
16:27 – Energy Conservation Analogy
17:05 – Example 2: Minimal Surface of Revolution (Catenary Derivation)
24:22 – Case 3: Integrand $f$ is Independent of $y'$ ($f_{y'} = 0$)
26:56 – Example 3: Degenerate / No-Extremal Case
30:03 – Case 4: Integrand $f$ is Independent of Both $x$ and $y$
33:53 – Family of Straight Lines & Singular Branch Analysis
38:05 – Case 5: Integrand $f$ is Linear in $y'$ (Trap / Meaningless Case)
42:25 – Complete Summary & Next Lecture (Brachistochrone Problem)

Ye lecture B.Sc Maths, M.Sc Mathematics, CSIR NET Mathematical Sciences, GATE aur IIT JAM aspirants ke liye highly useful hai.
